name: IconButton
description: An icon-only button. Renders a square, accessible button that displays a single icon. Requires an `aria-label` prop to ensure screen reader users understand its purpose.

notes: aria-label is REQUIRED. A console error is logged in development if it is missing.
When loading, aria-busy is set to true and the button is disabled.
Focus indicator uses a 2px outline with a 2px offset using var(--color-border-focus).
The icon itself is wrapped in an aria-hidden span so the label is the sole text alternative.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for the button. REQUIRED — must describe the action, not the icon shape. Example: 'Close dialog', not 'X icon'.

icon.description: The icon to display. Typically an SVG element or icon component.

variant.description: Visual style of the button. Maps directly to action color tokens.

size.description: Size of the button, controlling the square dimensions and icon size.

disabled.description: Disables the button. Applies reduced opacity and prevents interaction.

loading.description: Shows a loading spinner and disables the button. Sets aria-busy=true.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply.

variants.ghost: Low-emphasis icon action. Common for toolbar actions.
variants.destructive: Destructive icon action, e.g., a delete icon.

do: Always provide a descriptive aria-label that describes the action performed.
Use ghost variant for icon buttons in toolbars and dense UIs.
Pair with a visible tooltip to reinforce the icon meaning.
dont: Do not omit aria-label — this will cause an accessibility violation.
Do not use aria-label values like 'icon' or 'button' — be specific about the action.
Do not place text children inside IconButton — use Button instead.
